title: PM Support Contract
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE ARMY > USACE > MVD > W07V ENDIST N ORLEANS
description:
THIS NOTICE IS FOR SOURCES SOUGHT ONLY. THIS IS NOT A REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL OR INVITATION FOR BID. SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATIONS AND DRAWINGS ARE NOT AVAILABLE. 

 This notice does not constitute a commitment by the Government. All information submitted in response to this announcement is voluntary and the Government will not pay for information requested nor will it compensate any respondent for any cost incurred in developing information provided to the Government. Respondents will not be notified of the Sources Sought results. This Sources Sought is issued for the sole purpose of conducting Market Research in accordance with the Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) Part 10 and identifying vendors capable of fulfilling Agency needs. USACE personnel may contact firms responding to this announcement to clarify a responder’s capabilities and other matters as part of this market research process. 

 The tracking number for this announcement is   W912P827SSA001.   Please include in your firm’s response to this Sources Sought request. 

 USACE anticipates a requirement under the North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code 541330, Engineering Services. 

 The Government contemplates and unrestricted procurement with a reserve for Small Business concerns for a Firm Fixed Price Multiple Award Task Order Contracts (MATOC) for MVN Civil Works Program & Project Management Support Services. 

  

 The requirement: USACE New Orleans District seeks responsive and responsible small business offerors who shall provide services for the Civil Works Program & Project Management Support Services for efforts related to the water resources programs in southern Louisiana including USACE Civil Works Programs. Services include project management/planning support, development of project performance reports, updates to program management plans, project scheduling input, project cost support, presentation development, interagency agreement development /updates, project drawings and maps, other project reports, and monthly status reports. 

 Qualifications: 

 The contractor shall have the capability of providing project management and planning support, development of project performance reports, updates to Project/Program Management Plans (PMPs), project scheduling analysis, project cost tracking support, development of project performance reports, project cost tracking support, development of briefings and presentations, interagency agreement support, mapping and spatial project visual support, and monthly contract status reports. 

  

 The contractor shall formulate flood risk management, navigation, and ecosystem restoration plans supported by quantitative benefits analysis. 

 The contractor shall conduct studies, inventory and forecast of problems and opportunities, formulation of measures and alternative plans, evaluation and comparison of alternatives plans, evaluation and comparison of alternatives, calculation and comparison of monetized and non-monetized benefits. 

 The contractor shall prepare documents such as federal interest determination, reconnaissance, feasibility, post-authorization and other reports, including cultural resources studies and reports, and hazardous, toxic, and radiological waste (HTRW) investigations, National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA) and /or other environmental quality documents. 

 The contractor shall document water and wastewater issues as necessary to develop master plan level documents for environmental infrastructure, PAS, SJ, CAP, and other programs as required. 

  The contractor shall develop ecosystems habitat surveys, endangered or threatened species surveys, wetlands assessments using standard State of Louisiana methods in coopetition with other Federal and State agencies, modeling, and mitigation and monitoring plans. 

 The contractor shall coordinate with Corps, non-Federal partners, and other stakeholders to document existing flood damage problems, historical flood maps, potential ecosystem restoration, and recreation problems and opportunities within the study area. 

 The contractor shall coordinate with Corps and non-Federal partners to document required excavation permits, utility easements, rights-of-way, and other project-related requirements shortly after exercising this contract. 

 The contractor shall document all or part of NEPA and/or other environmental documents, including, but not limited to, Biological and HTRW assessments, Environmental Assessments (EA), and Environmental Impact Statements (Els's). 

 Potential sources are requested to submit: 

 
	 A Capability statement identifying current or previous contracts, scope and magnitude of Program & Project Management Support Services. 
 

 Please note: All contractors doing business with the Federal Government must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database. The website for registration Potential firms MUST have an active record in the System for Award Management (SAM) database to be considered for award. 

 Include in your capabilities package: your company's name, address, Point of Contact with corresponding phone number, e-mail address, Unique Entity Identifier Number, Cage Code, and System for Award Management profile which displays the expiration date. Proof of small business size must also be included. All interested firms are invited to submit a capability statement of no more than five (5) pages back and front, and no smaller than 12-point Times New Roman font. The capability statement should demonstrate the interested firm's understanding, capability, approach, qualifications, and past experience as it relates to the work stated within this Source Sought notice.
